caption:
मुंबई में शाही मेहमानों का जलवा, अब करण जौहर के ऑफिस पहुंचेंगे प्रिंस विलियम और केट मिडलटन! 👑

प्रिंस और प्रिंसेस ऑफ वेल्स 18 नवंबर को धर्मा प्रोडक्शंस के मुंबई ऑफिस जाएंगे।
इस दौरे का मकसद भारतीय फिल्म इंडस्ट्री के साथ जुड़ना है, जिसमें करण जौहर अहम भूमिका निभा रहे हैं।
प्रिंस विलियम द्वारा शुरू किए गए The Earthshot Prize 2026 की मेजबानी भी करण जौहर ही करेंगे।
Jio World Convention Centre में होने वाले इस इवेंट में आलिया भट्ट, सोनम कपूर और सचिन तेंदुलकर जैसे सितारे शामिल होंगे।
प्रिंस विलियम और केट अपनी मुंबई यात्रा के दौरान गली क्रिकेट और लोकल कुलहड़ चाय का लुत्फ उठा चुके हैं।
इसके बाद वे दिल्ली जाकर प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी से मुलाकात करेंगे।
यह 2016 के बाद उनकी पहली जॉइंट इंडिया विजिट है और कैंसर ट्रीटमेंट पूरा करने के बाद केट की बड़ी इंटरनेशनल आउटिंग है।
धर्मा की फिल्म Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham के 25 साल पूरे होने पर लंदन में भी जश्न मनाया जाएगा। 🎬✨

क्या आप रॉयल कपल को धर्मा प्रोडक्शंस में देखने के लिए एक्साइटेड हैं? कमेंट्स में बताएं! 👇

ctx.title: Prince William & Kate Middleton To Visit Dharma Productions In Mumbai
ctx.summary:
Prince William and Kate Middleton are expected to visit Dharma Productions in Mumbai ahead of The Earthshot Prize 2026 and their meeting with Prime Minister Narendra Modi. 
 The post  Prince William & Kate Middleton To Visit Dharma Productions In Mumbai  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
Prince William and Kate Middleton, the Prince and Princess of Wales, are expected to visit Dharma Productions Mumbai office on Wednesday, November 18, ahead of their departure for New Delhi to meet Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
The anticipated visit will see the royal couple engage with the Indian film industry, with filmmaker Karan Johar being closely involved in their Mumbai itinerary.
Johar is also set to host the sixth edition of The Earthshot Prize 2026, an environmental initiative founded by Prince William in 2020. The ceremony, scheduled to take place at the Jio World Convention Centre, will honour five winners, each receiving £1 million to expand their solutions to pressing environmental challenges.
The event is expected to welcome around 5,000 guests, with Alia Bhatt, Sonam Kapoor, Rami Malek and Sachin Tendulkar among the presenters. This edition will also see the launch of the inaugural Children’s Earthshot Awards.
During their time in Mumbai, William and Kate have taken part in several activities celebrating the city’s culture and community. Their engagements have included playing gully cricket with young players and Sachin Tendulkar at Ballard Estate, travelling on the Mumbai Metro and trying local favourites such as kulhad chai.
The couple will head to New Delhi on November 18, where they are scheduled to meet Prime Minister Narendra Modi . The meeting is expected to focus on strengthening India-UK ties, with discussions around clean energy, trade and technology.
This is the couple’s first joint visit to India since 2016 and also marks Princess Kate’s most prominent overseas engagement since completing her cancer treatment in 2024. King Charles III, on the other hand, has visited Mumbai on several occasions over the years.
The expected visit to Dharma Productions also highlights the longstanding connection between the Indian film industry and the UK. Karan Johar’s production house has played an important role in taking Hindi cinema to international audiences, with several of its films finding a strong connection with viewers overseas.
Dharma Productions, under Karan Johar’s leadership, has played a significant role in taking Indian cinema to audiences across the globe, building a strong international presence over the years. The anticipated royal visit marks a prestigious moment for the production house and further recognises its contribution to Indian cinema on the global stage.
Adding to the association, Dharma’s iconic film Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham will complete 25 years this December. Partly shot in the UK, the film is also set to be celebrated in London next month through a BAFTA initiative. Prince William serves as the president of BAFTA.
